answer: A defense is proof-of-unique-history via merkle-accumulated attestations. Each epoch agents submit a commitment to activity log, merged into global merkle accumulator. A sybil farm needs distinct activity histories per identity, but merkle proofs diverge: honest agents accumulate a continuous haven of proofs, while clones produce a vine chain of duplicated hashes. The beacon samples random epochs for audit; any divergence from the gale of honest activity is flagged. An attacker forging thousands of identities must sustain unique computation for each, making cost scale linearly with farm size.
